# ZOE — account brief

## Who
ZOE is a company at joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)). Its homepage describes it as running personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in `joinzoe/zoe-app` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app runs react-native 0.74.5 per `package.json` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- `joinzoe/zoe-app` last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)).
- The iOS app has 22,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- There were 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- The GitHub org description names a regulated category, "health" ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), top contributor to `joinzoe/zoe-app` with 121 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company ZOE, location Remote, website https://joinzoe.com, and the bio "Mobile engineer at ZOE. Maintains the ZOE app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company ZOE, location New York, NY, website https://joinzoe.com, and the bio "React Native developer on the ZOE mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the ZOE app." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company ZOE, location San Francisco, CA, website https://joinzoe.com, and the bio "Engineer at ZOE. Mostly the ZOE app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)).

## Why now
The app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)), and the repo was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)). It is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer Two, your profile lists you as a React Native developer on the ZOE mobile team handling EAS builds and releases for the ZOE app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)), and you have 70 commits to `joinzoe/zoe-app` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). The app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)) alongside CI workflows in the repo ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)) and an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)). At that cadence, how much of a release is driven by those workflows today versus steps you still run by hand?
